exposure: Smt. Prayagakka Karad Arogya yojana (SPKASY) health scheme services
cohort: The study included 60 beneficiaries from 211 villages who possessed Smt. Prayagakka Karad Arogya scheme (SPKASY) health cards.
finding: Awareness regarding the facilities offered by the SPKASY scheme is generally low, yet a majority of participants have utilized various services, particularly CT scan, MRI, 2D ECHO, and NICU.
